profile.headline: Co-Founder of Code Equal | Software Engineer at Microsoft

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description: A nonprofit dedicated to giving primarily underrepresented minorities opportunities to learn code. There are two classes, Code It & Girl Code, one is co-ed, the other is all girls, both have two levels, running during the school year. To date over 400 students have gone through the org. Locations: Princeton, the Bronx, Trenton, and soon Detroit and Omaha. As seen on the Tonight Show with Jimmy Fallon and mentioned in the New York Times.

positions.title: Explore Intern
positions.description: Worked in the Microsoft Teams Audio Conferencing group, eight weeks as a developer and four weeks as a PM creating a real time data analytics dashboard, querying data from Azure Cosmos DB presented on a web page in order to improve resource allocation and business intelligence.

positions.title: Policy Intern
positions.description: Conducted legislative research on various topics such as technology, immigration, and women’s rights. Handled constituent correspondence, attended briefings & hearings, as well as wrote memos and legislative recommendations. Organized the first Congressional App Challenge Hackathon in NJ 12 in the hopes of fostering a sense of curiosity in STEM in underrepresented minorities.

company.name: U.S. House of Representatives, Office of Congresswoman Bonnie Watson Coleman

positions.title: Instructor Assistant
positions.description: Taught girls ages 13-18 to code in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Ruby, and Swift in NYC, Omaha, and Detroit. To date, the CS camps across the nation, founded by Karlie Kloss, have reached and empowered around 2,000 young women.

honors.title: New Jersey Senate and General Assembly Resolution
honors.description: Awarded for work on advancing racial equality in Princeton
honors.issuer: Issued by New Jersey Senate and General Assembly, Congressman Bonnie Watson Coleman · Jun 2018

honors.title: Princeton Police Benevolent Award
honors.description: Awarded for dedication to community service and leadership

volunteerExperiences.description:
● Princeton High School Volunteer Liaison-LINC (September 2016 – June 2018).
● Volunteer at several community events: Communiversity, Halloween Parade, Day of the Dead (organizational role), Cinco de Mayo (organizational role), Festival Cultural Latino​ (organizational role), ​ACP’s 50t​h​ Anniversary,​ ​Princyclopedia​, and several open houses.
● Teaching Assistant in several art classes.
● Volunteer photographer at several art openings, fundraising events, and others.

● Board member of the T​een Advisory Board​ (September 2017-June 2018).
● Computer Science Instructor for for Code Equal's Python classes: C​ode It​ & ​Girl Code.​
● Volunteer assistant at storytelling in Spanish (2008-2011).
